description: Election Commission - Declare that I. A. K. Rahman as a member of the Colombo Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in the Colombo Municipal Council due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local government body, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new council member by a recognized political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7), which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
